scientific_integrity: The hemispherical 1/4 plateau is a known baseline and is not presented as new. The one-sided beyond-hemisphere transition, sharp coefficient, and marked rare-event law are the claimed contribution; priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Fixed exactly three vertices on S^2, surface-area uniform cap law, small one-sided excess beyond a hemisphere; marked convergence is weak, not total variation. Numerical checks do not certify the infinite limit, and historical completeness is not claimed.
title: A cubic-logarithmic pole-containment transition for three random spherical-cap vertices
